notes: Source: official ClearOne datasheet DST-0000-000 Rev2.1 (20191111), part number 910-3200-009-D, fetched from https://www.clearone.com/sites/default/files/2020-07/CONVERGE%20Pro%202%20128VTD%2020191111.pdf. Mic/Line I/O uses 3.81mm Phoenix/Euroblock terminal blocks (12 inputs on one 4-position/orange connector set, 8 outputs on one 3-position/black connector set) — modeled here as two aggregate euroblock ports (In/Out) per datasheet's connector packaging rather than 20 discrete jacks, matching how ClearOne ships them (qty 12 input terminal blocks + qty 8 output terminal blocks in the box, each accepting multiple channels per block). GPIO is a single 6-position Euroblock (Control/Status/Variable-Voltage, not audio) — connector mapped to euroblock with no grade. USB Audio (rear, USB-B) and USB Control (front panel, USB-B) are both listed as "USB 2.0, USB 3.0 compatible" without specifying a 3.0 generation (5G/10G); graded conservatively as usb-2.0 since the higher-speed generation isn't stated and these are low-bandwidth control/audio-class links, not data-transfer ports. Ethernet and VoIP ports are 10/100Mbps (eth-100m); Dante Primary/Secondary are Gigabit (eth-1g). C-Link and P-Link are proprietary RJ-45 expansion/peripheral buses (not standard IP Ethernet) — connector set to rj45 but grade omitted since ClearOne does not state an Ethernet PHY speed for them. P-Link In port also carries PoE 802.3af Mode B power input (48-56V) to power peripherals, in addition to signal — noted but not modeled as a separate power port since it is peripheral-bus power output, not the unit's own power input. AC inlet is listed only as "AC Inlet, 100-240V AC" in the datasheet; retailer spec sheets (e.g. B&H-style listings) commonly describe it as an IEC connector, consistent with the included 6' grounded IEC-style power cord — mapped to "iec" (standard IEC C13/C14) though the exact C13 vs C14 gender on the chassis wasn't explicitly spelled out. Telephone port (RJ11, POTS) has no connector id in the allowed list matching a phone jack exactly; mapped to rj45 as the closest available 8P8C-family id is not ideal either — RJ11 is a distinct 6P/4P connector from RJ45, so this is a best-effort mapping given the constrained connector enum (no rj11 option exists in the provided list).

ports.name: Mic/Line In
ports.note: 12 balanced mic/line inputs on 3.81mm Phoenix/Euroblock terminal blocks (4-position, orange), qty 12 connectors supplied

ports.name: Mic/Line Out
ports.note: 8 balanced mic/line outputs on 3.81mm Phoenix/Euroblock terminal blocks (3-position, black), qty 8 connectors supplied

ports.name: USB Audio
ports.note: Rear panel; 2x2 bidirectional digital audio, 24-bit/48kHz; listed as USB 2.0/3.0 compatible, generation of 3.0 not specified

ports.name: USB Control
ports.note: Front panel; listed as USB 2.0/3.0 compatible, generation of 3.0 not specified

ports.name: Telephone (POTS)
ports.note: Actual connector is RJ11 (analog telco/POTS line); no RJ11 id exists in the allowed connector list, mapped to rj45 as closest available modular-jack id

ports.name: VoIP
ports.note: 10/100Mbps Ethernet, auto-negotiation, supports up to 5 SIP lines

ports.name: Dante Primary
ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet, 16x16 bidirectional Dante audio channels, 24-bit/48-96kHz

ports.name: C-Link In
ports.note: Proprietary DSP expansion bus (RJ-45, Cat5e/6 cable), 64 expansion channels; not standard IP Ethernet, grade omitted

ports.name: C-Link Out
ports.note: Proprietary DSP expansion bus (RJ-45, Cat5e/6 cable); not standard IP Ethernet, grade omitted

ports.name: P-Link In
ports.note: Proprietary peripheral bus (RJ-45, Cat5e/6 cable); also supplies PoE 802.3af Mode B power (48-56V) to daisy-chained peripherals

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: DB9 female, serial commands, up to 115200 baud

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: 6-position 5.08mm Phoenix/Euroblock (green); control, status, and variable-voltage I/O, not audio signal

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: AC Inlet, 100-240V AC 50/60Hz auto-sensing; datasheet states "AC Inlet" without specifying IEC C13/C14 explicitly, inferred from included grounded IEC-style power cord
